name: Gemma-2-27B
notes: Official card (HF gated, card text read via page) + Gemma 2 report Table 13: MMLU 75.2, MATH 42.3 - card reports MMLU/MATH not MMLU-Pro/MATH-500, so those are null. No GPQA in report/card (HF community eval 40.9 disregarded). IFEval 91.1 from Gemma 3 report Table 18 (Google's own Gemma 2 27B comparison eval). 27B per official docs (card lists PT 27B).

name: Gemma-3-4B
notes: Official Gemma 3 report (IT models): Table 6 MMLU-Pro 43.6, GPQA Diamond 30.8; Table 18 IFEval 90.2. Report MATH 75.6 is MATH not MATH-500 -> null. Params 4.3B = 3,209M non-emb + 675M emb + 417M SigLIP vision encoder (report Table 1). Released 2025-03-12 (official blog + HF).

name: Gemma-3-27B
notes: Official Gemma 3 report (IT): Table 6 MMLU-Pro 67.5, GPQA Diamond 42.4; Table 18 IFEval 90.4. MATH 89.0 in report is MATH not MATH-500 -> null. Params 27.4B = 25,600M non-emb + 1,416M emb + 417M vision (report Table 1); card lists only PT tables (MMLU-Pro COT 52.2 PT). Released 2025-03-12.

name: Gemma-3n-E4B
notes: Official card: MMLU (Pro) 50.6 and GPQA Diamond 23.7, both 0-shot. 8B raw total / 4B effective (official dev guide + card). NOT MoE - dense arch with MatFormer selective parameter activation + Per-Layer Embeddings; card's 'E4B contains E2B sub-model'. Release date 2025-06-26 (HF blog datePublished + dev guide), previewed 2025-05-20 at I/O. No IFEval published.

name: Gemma-4-E2B
notes: Official Gemma 4 card: MMLU Pro 60.0, GPQA Diamond 43.4 (with thinking, per shared family table). 2.3B effective / 5.1B with embeddings (Per-Layer Embeddings, dense). No MATH-500/IFEval published for Gemma 4. Smallest Gemma 4; not previously in DB (only E4B was). Launched 2026-04-02 with the family.

name: Gemma-4-12B
notes: Official card: MMLU Pro 77.2, GPQA Diamond 78.8. 11.95B dense, encoder-free 'Unified' multimodal (audio+vision), 256K ctx. Released 2026-06-03 per blog.google 'Introducing Gemma 4 12B' (added 2 months after family launch 2026-04-02). No MATH-500/IFEval published. Not in DB.

name: Gemma-4-26B-A4B
notes: Official card: MMLU Pro 82.6, GPQA Diamond 82.3. 25.2B total / 3.8B active (card 'Total 25.2B, Active 3.8B, 8 active/128 total + 1 shared experts') - NOT 4B active as commonly quoted. 256K ctx, image+text. No MATH-500/IFEval published. Launched 2026-04-02. Not in DB.
